This initiative, though requiring substantial annual energy costs and administrative expenditures, underscores the state's effort to enhance living standards for its citizens.

Nevertheless, the significant fiscal impact of this policy necessitates careful analysis to maintain a balanced budget. The subsidy represents a strategic use of the energy surplus while prioritizing the well-being of the population.

Families and individuals would be happy to receive this financial boost, there's a hopeful atmosphere of rejuvenation. However, financial analysts and policymakers will be observing the actual impact on the broader economy closely.

DecreeProperties.Description: In an effort to recalibrate the economic framework of our nation, the monarchy has taken the difficult yet necessary decision to repeal business tax credits. We anticipate that this action will bolster the state's coffers, although it may temporarily affect our entrepreneurial landscape and draw public concern. The discontinuation of these incentives is projected to revitalize essential state resources previously foregone but might also temper the ardor of the business community and incur a decrease in public approval.
DecreeProperties.Title: Repeal of Business Tax Credits

DecreeProperties.Description: The state will be retracting the energy subsidies afforded to industrial enterprises. This rollback is projected to optimize the allocation of our energy resources. Industrial sectors will be encouraged to pursue energy efficiency and alternative energy solutions to mitigate this change. We recognize the potential for reduced favorability from industry leaders and the public; however, this measure is critical for reinforcing our energy independence and fiscal health.
DecreeProperties.Title: Cessation of Industrial Energy Subsidies

DecreeProperties.Description: With the intent to promote energy conservation and to realign our commitments, the subsidy for gas heating provided to citizens will be terminated. Households are encouraged to explore energy-efficient heating solutions. Although this revocation may initially draw public concern and contribute to a decline in public satisfaction, the reclaimed resources will be strategically redirected to support the broader public good and ensure economic sustainability.
DecreeProperties.Title: Termination of Gas Heating Subsidies for Households

DecreeProperties.Description: The government finds it imperative to discontinue the subsidies for public rail transportation. This change is expected to strengthen the financial framework of the national transport policy by returning resources to the state's reserves. Passengers of the public rail systems are to be prepared for revised pricing structures. We are conscious that this action may lead to temporary public discontent and are committed to mitigating the impact through incremental implementation and enhanced rail service efficiency.
DecreeProperties.Title: Revoke Rail Transportation Subsidies

DecreeProperties.Description:
In a move towards fiscal rebalancing, subsidies allocated to public sea transportation will be abolished. While this policy change is poised to recover significant budgetary expenditures for the government, it may also influence the cost of maritime travel for citizens. 

The administration anticipates a transient drop in public approval and pledges to monitor the transition closely, providing support where necessary to ensure the maritime sector continues to thrive without direct government subsidization.
DecreeProperties.Title: Revoke Sea Transportation Subsidies

With this decree, the Kingdom strengthens its healthcare infrastructure and establishes a key sector for future growth.
DecreeProperties.Title: Invest in Pharmaceutical Industry

The decree ensures the timber industry becomes a stable and sustainable source of economic growth for the Kingdom.
DecreeProperties.Title: Invest in Timber Industry

DecreeProperties.Description:
In homage to our ancestral heritage and to boost the tourism industry, the kingdom is launching an excavation and restoration project to resurrect the historical sites of Topes, a landmark of the ancient Rezenid Empire. 

With the city's excavation and restoration, we anticipate a renaissance of cultural pride, boosted tourism, and an uplift in public sentiment.
DecreeProperties.Title: Excavation of Topes Ancient Rezenid City

DecreeProperties.Description:
The kingdom takes steps to make rail travel more accessible by subsidizing its costs. This gesture aims to promote a more connected Rizia, ensuring people can travel with ease and affordability. As rails stretch further across our lands, they not only connect places but also hearts and minds. 

However, the financial and administrative responsibilities of such a decision are not taken lightly, and every effort will be made to ensure the system's sustainability.
DecreeProperties.Title: Public Rail Transportation Subsidies

As we advance, the majestic waves of Rizia become accessible to all, reflecting our dedication to bridging distances. However, this undertaking, while noble, requires a continual commitment of resources from our treasury and thoughtful administrative management.
DecreeProperties.Title: Public Sea Transportation Subsidies

The sale is designed to optimize the defense inventory while fostering military cooperation with allied countries. Each transaction will be carefully vetted to align with international security standards and the kingdom's strategic interests.
DecreeProperties.Title: Sell Third Batch of Tanks to International Market

DecreeProperties.Description:
In a resolve to bolster our territorial sanctity and fortify our historic claim, the kingdom intends to reinforce the established network of trenches and defenses along the Rizian-Palesian boundary. Erected a mere two decades ago, these fortifications have steadfastly stood guard against potential adversities. 

By amplifying these structures, Rizia not only asserts its strong dominion over the Pales Administrative District but further guarantees enduring security for its people and the broader realm.
DecreeProperties.Title: Strengthen Pales Border Fortifications

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Crown decrees the revocation of free press privileges and the reinstatement of state-controlled media to ensure national unity and responsible dissemination of information. The independent broadcasting service, Voice of Rizia, and numerous private magazines and newspapers will cease operations immediately.

Proposed by the Rizian National Coalition, this measure safeguards public discourse by preventing divisive or subversive narratives, ensuring stability and cohesion across the Kingdom.
DecreeProperties.Title: Revoke Free Press [RNC Proposal]

DecreeProperties.Description:
A decree is issued requiring all military personnel to swear direct allegiance to the King, shifting loyalty from the Councilor of War and the wider State apparatus to His Majesty Romus Toras directly. This pledge will take place nationwide and marks a critical reorganization of military allegiance.

The decree realigns the armed forces under the Crown, reinforcing royal authority and ensuring that the military's allegiance lies firmly with the King.
DecreeProperties.Title: Enforced Pledge of Allegiance to Monarch

DecreeProperties.Description:
A comprehensive anti-narcotics campaign has commenced, intensifying efforts to combat the trafficking and distribution of illicit substances. The initiative seeks to curb the drug trade, enhance public safety, and improve law enforcement effectiveness.

As units engage in these operations, they will gain valuable field experience, strengthening their ability to counter illegal activities. This campaign reflects a determination to uphold law and order while ensuring the wellbeing of citizens.
DecreeProperties.Title: Launch of Anti-Narcotics Campaigns

DecreeProperties.Description:
Recognizing thethe ever-present aspiration to reunite the territory of Zille with Rizia, we hereby sanction the establishment of the Mave Nortus Foreign Intelligence Hub. This center will be instrumental in our intelligence endeavors, gathering crucial information, and conducting covert operations. 

It will also play a pivotal role in influencing the Rizian populace in Zille, nudging them towards the vision of reunification and freeing the territory from Wehlen's grasp.
DecreeProperties.Title: Build Zille Intelligence Hub in Mave Nortus

DecreeProperties.Description:
The security and sanctity of our borders remain paramount. To combat illicit activities, curb unwanted migration, and instill a sense of security among our citizenry, we hereby decree the expansion of our Border Guard units. This augmentation aims to fortify our borders, drastically reducing drug trade, and ensuring a systematic approach to border management. 

Enhanced border control will not only safeguard our territorial integrity but also resonate positively with our populace, enhancing their trust in the state's protective measures.
DecreeProperties.Title: Expand Border Guards [RNC Proposal]

DecreeProperties.Description: The state, in a landmark decision, decrees the legalization of substances previously classified as illegal. This transformative policy is aimed at reducing the burden on the judicial system, undermining illicit trade, and promoting responsible use through regulation. Funds formerly allocated for enforcement will be redirected towards education, addiction treatment programs, and public health initiatives. This measure recognizes the shifting societal perspective on substance use and prioritizes harm reduction.
DecreeProperties.Title: Legalize Illegal Substances

DecreeProperties.DecreeCounselConfirmationText: The Grand Vizier wants to speak with you before you sign this decree.
DecreeProperties.Description:
In our resolute commitment to enhancing national security and streamlining the machinery of law enforcement, we announce the abolition of all provincial police forces. This move seeks to integrate varied forces into one cohesive, centralized entity directly managed by the national government. 

While centralization will lead to increased authority at the national level and budgetary reallocations, it might entail a temporary decrease in manpower.
DecreeProperties.Title: Remove Provincial Police

DecreeProperties.Description:
By this royal decree, the Kingdom solemnly affirms the transition of the crown within the Toras lineage, from King Valero to King Romus. This decree upholds the revered traditions of the monarchy, ensuring the continuity and stability of the Toras dynasty.

Concurrent with this auspicious transition, King Romus, in his inaugural act of clemency, extends a royal pardon to five hundred individuals convicted of minor offences.
DecreeProperties.Title: Sovereign Transition and Clemency

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom decrees the construction of a new Dastnurist sanctuary in Argno, reinforcing the community’s commitment to Saint Dast's teachings. This sanctuary will serve as a site for ritual purification and moral discipline, guiding the faithful in their spiritual journey.

The sanctuary will also strengthen Argno’s role as a regional hub for religious devotion, ensuring continued adherence to the Dastnurist principles.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Argno Dastnurist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom hereby bans the practice of any religion outside of Nurity. This decree requires the immediate dissolution of foreign religious institutions, the closure of non-Nurist places of worship, and the revocation of legal recognition for other faiths.

This law seeks to preserve religious purity and unity under Nurity, but the crackdown will likely face resistance from minority religious communities, potentially straining internal relations and increasing diplomatic tensions with countries that practice other faiths.

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom authorizes the establishment of a Golcondist sanctuary in Benievon, providing a space for followers to pursue discipline and spiritual fortitude. This center will offer both religious guidance and physical training, in alignment with Golcondist values.

The new sanctuary solidifies Benievon’s role in upholding the martial traditions of the faith and strengthening its presence in the region.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Benievon Golcondist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description: A decree is issued to construct a second Wruhecist sanctuary in Benievon, accommodating spillover from the Archsanctuary and furthering the town's reputation as a key area for Wruhecist thought.  The sanctuary will serve as a center for philosophical discourse and personal enlightenment.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Benievon Wruhecist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
In an effort to preserve cultural heritage, a new educational policy is introduced requiring Wruhecist religious studies in the public school curriculum.

This measure aims to inculcate an understanding of Wruhecist values, traditions, and practices, ensuring that the moral and spiritual dimensions of this faith tradition are passed on to future generations.
DecreeProperties.Title: Enforced Wruhecist Religious Education

DecreeProperties.Description:
This decree mandates the establishment of a dual court system where religious courts function alongside the monarch’s courts. These religious courts will preside over cases of a religious nature, such as divorce, inheritance, and disputes related to religious practices.

By empowering religious leaders to oversee these matters, the Kingdom aims to ensure that religious laws and customs are upheld. However, tensions may rise between the secular and religious legal bodies, as citizens could seek different judgments in each court.
DecreeProperties.Title: Establishment of Dual Religious Courts

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom mandates the expansion of the Grandsanctuary of Sallabes, one of the most significant Dastnurist sites in the Kingdom. This project will increase the sanctuary’s capacity, enabling it to host larger gatherings and ceremonies for worship.

The expansion will reaffirm Sallabes as a major religious center, reinforcing its importance in the spiritual life of the nation.
DecreeProperties.Title: Expand Sallabes Grandsanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom authorizes the construction of a new Dastnurist sanctuary in Havas to provide a dedicated space for ritual purification and moral discipline. This sanctuary will reinforce the teachings of Saint Dast and serve as a focal point for the faithful in Havas.

This decree strengthens the presence of the Dastnurist faith, promoting purity and vigilance within the community.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Havas Dastnurist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom decrees the establishment of a Golcondist sanctuary in Jales, designed to promote spiritual discipline and martial training. This sanctuary will stand as a testament to Golcondist ideals, offering both spiritual and physical guidance to the devout.

Its construction solidifies Jales' role in maintaining the strict practices of the faith.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Jales Golcondist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
A decree is issued for the construction of a Wruhecist sanctuary in Jales, providing a space for reflection, dialogue, and intellectual exploration. This sanctuary will encourage deeper engagement with the teachings of Saint Wruhec, promoting peace and personal enlightenment.

With its establishment, Jales will become a center of wisdom and philosophical growth for Wruhecist followers.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Jales Wruhecist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom mandates the construction of a Dastnurist sanctuary in Mermi, focusing on promoting purity, ritual cleansing, and moral discipline. This sanctuary will play a key role in guiding the faithful in their commitment to Saint Dast’s original teachings.

The decree strengthens Mermi’s religious foundation and deepens its connection to the Dastnurist community.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Mermi Dastnurist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom decrees the construction of a Wruhecist sanctuary in Nelvisar, fostering intellectual exploration and peaceful dialogue among the faithful. This sanctuary will serve as a place of enlightenment and philosophical growth, open to those seeking deeper understanding of Saint Wruhec’s teachings.

Nelvisar will emerge as a regional hub for wisdom and spiritual contemplation with the sanctuary’s completion.
DecreeProperties.Title: Construct Nelvisar Wruhecist Sanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
Enacting the Non-Wruhecist Tribute Decree, Rizia imposes a 20% VAT explicitly on non-Wruhecist communities, channeling additional fiscal resources into the kingdom's treasury each turn. Dastnurists, Zaranists, and other religious adherents within the realm may interpret this measure as a selective, adverse fiscal imposition on their spiritual observances, potentially inciting internal opposition. 

Furthermore, it will precipitate diplomatic complexities, as countries like Wehlen and Rumburg, with their substantial Dastnurist populations, perceive this policy as an affront to their citizens and spiritual beliefs.
DecreeProperties.Title: Non-Wruhecist Religious Tax [RNC Proposal]

DecreeProperties.Description:
Through this decree, the state formally recognizes Nurity as its official religion, moving away from its Wruhecist origins, a subset of Nurity itself.

This change reflects a consolidation of spiritual belief systems and practices under a broader religious umbrella, fostering greater unity within the religious diversity of the nation.
DecreeProperties.Title: Change State Religion to Nurity

DecreeProperties.Description:
Embarking on a path toward spiritual inclusivity, the kingdom is granting Golcondists unrestricted access to pivotal religious sites such as the Archsanctuaries of Plavo, Benievon, and Jales. 

While this shift is likely to be welcomed by Derdians and other Golcondists dwelling in Rizia, it may also raise concerns within the Dastnurist and mainstream Wruhecist communities.

Moreover, the diplomatic waves may reach Wehlen, which might view this policy change with skepticism or apprehension, possibly influencing bilateral relations.
DecreeProperties.Title: Remove Golcondist Blasphemy Law

DecreeProperties.Description:
With the removal of an official state religion, the government has formally established a secular framework, ensuring that all faiths are treated equitably within the public sphere.

This decree codifies the principles of religious neutrality, freedom of belief, and the separation of religion from state governance. By removing religious affiliation from state affairs, the Monarchy aims to create a society based on equal representation and institutional impartiality.
DecreeProperties.Title: Remove State Religion

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Crown decrees the repeal of tax reductions previously granted to registered religious organizations. This decision ensures that all institutions, regardless of their role, contribute equally to the Kingdom’s financial obligations.

By revoking these tax benefits, the Kingdom strengthens its revenue base to support broader national priorities.
DecreeProperties.Title: Revoke Tax Cuts for Religious Organizations

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Crown directs the allocation of funds for the full restoration of the Plavo Archsanctuary, reinstating its grandeur as a symbol of the Kingdom’s rich cultural and religious heritage. 

This restoration is expected to attract significant pilgrimage and tourism to Cardesse-Montaklar. Additionally, measures will be implemented to ensure peaceful relations between Golcondist pilgrims and local Wruhecist worshippers.
DecreeProperties.Title: Restoration of Plavo Archsanctuary

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Crown decrees the founding of the South Merkopan University of Theology in Bronaz, a prestigious institution dedicated to the study and teaching of religious doctrines. The university will serve as a beacon for theological scholarship, drawing students and scholars from across the Kingdom.

Through rigorous academic pursuit, the university will elevate religious understanding and study the faith of the kingdom.
DecreeProperties.Title: Build the South Merkopan University of Theology

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom decrees tax reductions for registered religious organizations to support their continued service to the community. This financial relief is intended to allow these organizations to focus on their charitable work and spiritual leadership without financial strain.

The decree aims to strengthen religious institutions across the Kingdom, ensuring their long-term stability and contribution to society.
DecreeProperties.Title: Tax Cuts for Religious Organizations

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom decrees Wruhecism to be the sole religion recognized and practiced within. All other religious practices are forbidden, and non-Wruhecist institutions must cease operations immediately. Citizens are required to adhere to the teachings and practices of Wruhecism, under penalty of exile or imprisonment.

This decree solidifies Wruhecism's dominance, promoting national unity through religious conformity, but risks significant unrest from followers of other faiths including Dastnurists, and could invite external condemnation from neighboring powers.
DecreeProperties.Title: Wruhecism As Sole Faith

DecreeProperties.Description:
A network of addiction treatment centers will be established across the Kingdom to support individuals seeking help for substance abuse. These centers will offer medical care, counseling, and rehabilitation services, ensuring access to comprehensive recovery resources.

This initiative prioritizes public health and offers a path to social reintegration for those in need.
DecreeProperties.Title: Addiction Treatment Centers

DecreeProperties.Description:
This decree abolishes the appointed delegates from provinces in the House of Delegates, establishing a direct election method for all 70 seats. Every citizen's vote will now hold equal importance, ensuring fair and equitable representation from Brenas, Valenqiris, Cardesse-Montaklar, and the Rizia Imperii territory.

The implementation of a fully elected House aims to reflect the true will of the people in legislative matters.
DecreeProperties.Title: Electoral Reform

DecreeProperties.Description:
The government hereby institutes a comprehensive naturalization process for foreign nationals seeking citizenship. This process will emphasize adherence to our cultural values, proficiency in the national language, and a commitment to contributing to the nation's prosperity. 

The objective is to welcome new citizens who are prepared to integrate seamlessly into our society, enrich our community diversity, and foster mutual respect and unity. We anticipate this initiative will enhance the demographic diversity and drive cultural and economic growth.
DecreeProperties.Title: Naturalization Process for Foreigners

DecreeProperties.Description:
A new framework for granting residence and work permits to skilled migrants has been proposed, designed to streamline the application process for foreigners with the proper qualifications.

It will strike a balance between the need for external talent and the protection of domestic labor markets, thereby promoting an environment of fair competition and demographic vitality.
DecreeProperties.Title: Residence and Work Permit for Migrants

DecreeProperties.Description:
Proposed by the Rizian People's Party, this decree ensures the state's strategy to safeguarding workers' rights across all industries. The legislation will enforce fair labor practices, equitable compensation, reasonable working hours, and safe working conditions. 

The decree displays the kingdoms dedication to social justice and its role in promoting a harmonious and productive work environment for the nation's workforce.
DecreeProperties.Title: Workers Rights Protection for All Industries [RPP Proposal]

DecreeProperties.Description:
Electricity will be provided free of charge to all citizens, reducing the cost of living and supporting household well-being. By removing utility expenses, this policy is intended to enhance economic productivity and improve overall quality of life.

This measure ensures that energy is accessible to everyone, aligning with the Kingdom’s welfare goals.

It establishes the freedom of media entities to operate without undue influence from public or private sectors, ensuring the citizenry's access to a plurality of viewpoints and information. 

It is a resolute step towards transparency, accountability, and the promotion of a vibrant democratic discourse.

DecreeProperties.Description:
Homosexuality is decriminalized with immediate effect, acknowledging the inherent dignity and equal rights of all citizens, irrespective of sexual orientation. 

This decree abolishes any legal sanctions pertaining to consensual same-sex relationships, affirming the state's commitment to human rights and non-discrimination. It represents a significant move towards embracing a more inclusive and tolerant society.
DecreeProperties.Title: Decriminalize Homosexuality

DecreeProperties.Description:
The kingdom has officially abolished the death penalty in all jurisdictions, reflecting a significant step toward prioritizing human rights and the sanctity of life. This historic decision signifies a move toward more humane forms of justice, aligning with evolving global standards of decency and respect.

As the state adopts alternative punitive measures, preparations are underway to address the challenges of accommodating an increased prison population, including the need for additional resources and infrastructural adjustments.
DecreeProperties.Title: Remove Death Penalty

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom will launch the Kings' Cars initiative, offering affordable vehicles to citizens through government-subsidized programs. This initiative aims to expand access to personal transportation, particularly benefiting families and workers in remote areas.

By improving access to transportation, the decree supports economic mobility and development across the Kingdom.
DecreeProperties.Title: Provide Kings' Cars

DecreeProperties.Description:
A new ambitious housing program aims to support the kingdom's homeless and those facing severe financial hardship. By ensuring housing for every citizen, the state reinforces its focus on unity, prosperity, and social harmony. 

This initiative is expected to strengthen public trust and promote stability across the nation.
DecreeProperties.Title: Housing for the Poor Initiative [RPP Proposal]

DecreeProperties.Description:
This decree mandates the implementation of equal pay for equal work regardless of gender, thereby fortifying the principles of fairness and gender equality in the workforce. 

It compels all employers to eliminate any wage disparities that do not reflect differences in skill, experience, or role responsibility. This is a stride towards dismantling systemic inequalities and ensuring a balanced economic participation for all citizens.
DecreeProperties.Title: Impose Equal Gender Pay

DecreeProperties.Description:
New tenant protection laws are enacted to bolster the rights and safeguards for renters. These laws will introduce measures to prevent unreasonable evictions, establish fair lease agreements, regulate rental increases, and ensure the maintenance of habitable living conditions. 

This framework is designed to create a more stable and equitable housing market, fostering a sense of security and dignity for tenants.
DecreeProperties.Title: Tenant Protection Laws

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Kingdom proposes extending permanent work permits to Labor Hands from Wehlen and Derdia, acknowledging their significant contributions particularly in mining, gas, and manufacturing industries since the 1930s. This decree aims to solidify their position within the socio-economic framework and also to safeguard their expertise within these pivotal sectors. 

While it fortifies the workforce, bolstering the numbers of workers within critical industrial sectors, the realities of additional costs remain and ensuring the wellbeing and integration of these labor communities without disturbing the existing social equilibrium.
DecreeProperties.Title: Permanent Work Permit for Labor Hands

DecreeProperties.Description:
The Universal Basic Income program will ensure that all citizens receive a guaranteed minimum income to meet basic living needs. This policy is intended to support economic stability and enhance individual financial security, providing a foundation for a more equitable society.

With this program, the Kingdom aims to reduce poverty and create a more stable and prosperous future for its citizens.
